title: Bushfire Hazard Report, 229 Halls Track Road, Sandfly (Kingborough, Tasmania): supporting report for a building permit for two dwellings, with BHMP sheet and Form 55 certificate (BushfireWise BW051v1, May 2025)
jurisdiction: Tasmania, Australia (Kingborough municipality). NON-ALBERTA comparative record.
code_edition: NCC edition not stated in the report (cites 'National Construction Code, Building Code of Australia'). AS 3959-2018. Tasmanian Director's Determination - Bushfire Hazard Areas (transitional) v2.3, 16 July 2024, as cited in the report.
document_date: Report dated May 2025 (PDF p.1, p.3). Version 1 dated 25/09/2025 (footers, PDF p.3-19). Form 55 certificate dated 26/05/2025 (PDF p.19). PDF creation date 2025-09-25 (metadata).

facts.text: Cover block: 'BushfireWise - Development Planning', 'Bushfire Hazard Report'. Location 229 Halls track Road, Sandfly. Applicant R. Saunders. Date May 2025. Certification number BW051v1. Author Mark Van den Berg, BFP-108. Version 1, version date 25/09/2025.

Purpose: the report addresses a new primary dwelling and an ancillary dwelling in a bushfire-prone area. It states that it demonstrates compliance with the Director's Determination - Bushfire Hazard Areas (transitional) v2.3 dated 16 July 2024, and that it includes a Form 55 Certificate of Qualified Person.
facts.locator: PDF p.3, section 1.0 Purpose (report page 3 of 10)

facts.text: Site details as printed: title reference 223516/1; municipality Kingborough; Kingborough Interim Planning Scheme 2015; zoning Rural Resource; land size about 44 ha; compliance pathway stated as 'Deemed to Satisfy'.
facts.locator: PDF p.3, section 2.0 Site Details; PDF p.4, section 5.0 Site Description

facts.text: The report says it 'will form part of supporting documentation for a building permit application for the construction of two new dwellings'.
BAL was assessed 'in accordance with Section 2 of AS 3959-2018: Simplified Procedure'. Stated BAL-29 for the primary dwelling and BAL-19 for the ancillary dwelling. The BAL tables are in Appendix A.
facts.locator: PDF p.5, section 6.0; PDF p.11-12 (Appendix A tables)

facts.text: Construction standard as written: 'In accordance with the National Construction Code and the Directors Determination s4.1', the two dwellings are to be built to AS3959 specifications for BAL-29 and BAL-19 respectively.

The compliance table reproduces the Determination row 'If BAL-40 or BAL-FZ, a Performance Solution is required (not DtS).' The same table records the practitioner's statements that the proposal complies with s4.1 and with s4.2 to s4.3. Those are the practitioner's statements, not a building authority's decision.
facts.locator: PDF p.8, section 8.0 (Table 3 heading: Determination 16 July 2024, version 2.3); PDF p.9 (Table 3 continued)

facts.text: Reference list cites the National Construction Code (Building Code of Australia) with no edition, Standards Australia AS3959-2018, the Building Amendment (Bushfire-Prone Areas) Regulations 2016, the Kingborough Interim Planning Scheme 2015, and the Director's Determination v2.3 of 16 July 2024.

Bushfire Hazard Management Plan sheet titled 'Bushfire Hazard Management Plan 229 Halls Track Road, Sandfly. May 2025. BW051v1.' It lists property-access and water-supply compliance requirements and 'Building Specifications as marked to AS3959-2018', and says it is to be read with the associated Bushfire Hazard Report.

Form 55 (Director of Building Control approved form, approved 1 July 2017): Certificate of Qualified Person - Assessable Item, certificate type 'Bushfire Hazard'. Qualified person Mark Van den Berg, licence BFP-108. Assessable item 'Bushfire hazard management plan for two new class 1a buildings'. Listed calculations 'AS 3959:2018 - Method 1 BAL assessment'.

Form 55 substance (the practitioner's certified statement): the building work, if built according to the referenced BHMP, 'will comply with the applicable Deemed-to-Satisfy requirements' of Determination v2.3. The BAL is stated as BAL-29 (primary) and BAL-19 (ancillary). Certificate date 26/05/2025.

Form 55 scope and limitations: scope limited to compliance with Determination v2.3; effectiveness depends on correct implementation and maintenance for the life of the development; 'No guarantee can be provided that the building work will survive every bushfire event.'
Appendix C is a heading page ('Appendix C - proposal plans') with no drawing text in the extracted layer. The plan content was not verified.

Form 55 signature and certificate-number fields: the text layer shows the labels 'Signed:' and 'Certificate No:' with no visible name beside them. The text 'BW051.v1. 26/05/2025' sits on the qualified-person line. Whether a signature image is present was not verified.
